decisions.reason: With the separate 15-day and 72-hour programs withdrawn, the multi-model express line is now the consolidated vehicle for fast delivery, so the option still has value and is worth keeping open.

The online ordering and digital services platform costs little to maintain, fits the firm's move toward deeper service and trade-partner support, and its upside is still uncertain, so keeping the option is justified.

The fire and smoke protection door sits within the certified core offer and meets steady compliance-driven demand at low holding cost, although its low visibility and the withdrawal of the fire-resistant door C raise the risk of consolidation slightly.
